page_title: BET 3-0 VAL | Betis v Valencia 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.

90+6' Mario Dominguez (Valencia) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Claudio Bravo, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
90+5' Diego Lopez (Valencia) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Valencia will take a throw-in.
90+3' Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+2' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.

90+1' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Gabriel Paulista (Valencia), who plants a header just wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
90+1' Javi Guerra (Valencia) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows the yellow card to German Pezzella (Betis) for a heavy challenge.
88' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Guido Rodriguez and he is replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
87' Having already used all their subs, Valencia are going to have to play the remainder of the game with one man down.
87' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
87' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
86' A substitution has been made. Pepelu goes off and Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) comes on.

85' 3 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) and William Carvalho gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top left corner. 3:0.

84' Mario Dominguez (Valencia) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
84' Pepelu (Valencia) sends the corner into the box, but Claudio Bravo intercepts it and averts the threat.

83' Pepelu (Valencia) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Claudio Bravo has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
82' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diego Lopez (Valencia). The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
81' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marc Roca (Betis) and blew his whistle.

80' Hector Bellerin (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is behind the touchline and Betis will take a throw-in.

79' What a wasted opportunity by Marc Roca (Betis)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mario Dominguez (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Fran Perez can be given a rest.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
75' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Borja Iglesias (Betis) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
73' Hugo Duro (Valencia) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

73' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball has crossed the sideline. Valencia are taking a throw-in.
72' Here is a change. Ayoze Perez is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Borja Iglesias (Betis).
72' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Assane Diao walks off.
69' Rodri (Betis) has a goal ruled out for offside!
69' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is penalised for holding. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a set piece.
68' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Andre Almeida is replaced by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
65' Juan Miranda (Betis) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
64' Andre Almeida (Valencia) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
62' Substitution. William Carvalho (Betis) replaces Isco.
61' Chadi Riad (Betis) was too forceful with his tackle and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
60' A lofted cross from Juan Miranda (Betis) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
56' The attendance is 50163.

52' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Marc Roca (Betis) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header into the top of the net. 2:0.
52' Isco (Betis) will take a corner kick.

51' Isco (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top right corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili easily deals with the threat. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' Assane Diao (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
49' Assane Diao (Betis) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a half-time substitution. Chadi Riad (Betis) comes on in place of Marc Bartra.
46' Half-time substitution. Roman Yaremchuk is replaced by Hugo Duro (Valencia).
46' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Diego Lopez (Valencia) comes on the pitch for Pablo Gozalbez.
46' The whistle blows and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea starts the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Pablo Gozalbez (Valencia) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
45+3' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul after Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) hacks down one of his opponents.
45+2' Marc Roca (Betis) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Isco (Betis) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
44' Marc Roca (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
44' Isco (Betis) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
43' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) for a tough tackle.
41' 1 - 0 Goal! Assane Diao (Betis) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.
40' Isco (Betis) will take the free kick.
40' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea ignores the protests.
40' Poor challenge! Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) is penalised for tripping and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Betis.
39' Isco (Betis) swings in a cross from the corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reads it well and gathers the ball.
39' Isco (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Isco (Betis) takes a short corner kick.
39' Juan Miranda (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Betis.

37' German Pezzella (Betis) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
37' Isco (Betis) takes a direct free kick.
36' Javi Guerra (Valencia) jumps into a tackle and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a foul. Betis get a free kick.
35' Pepelu (Valencia) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
35' Marc Bartra (Betis) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick to Valencia.
30' The referee blows for a cooling break.
30' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle and signals a foul after Pepelu (Valencia) brought his opponent down.
29' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Rodri (Betis).
27' Isco (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Giorgi Mamardashvili easily deals with the threat.
26' Hector Bellerin (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
26' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for an infringement.
25' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
23' Marc Roca (Betis) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
22' A pass from Rodri (Betis) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
21' Andre Almeida (Valencia) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea who sees an offensive foul.
20' Hector Bellerin (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
19' Isco (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
17' Rodri (Betis) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
17' Rodri (Betis) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
15' Pablo Gozalbez (Valencia) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
14' Hector Bellerin (Betis) is flagged for offside.
13' Flag goes up against Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Marc Roca (Betis) trips an opposition player and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a foul.
11' A yellow card for a tackle by Ayoze Perez (Betis). Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
11' Isco (Betis) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
11' Hector Bellerin (Betis) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
9' Unlucky! A great strike from Fran Perez (Valencia) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
7' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
6' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Isco (Betis) inside the box.

5' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
3' Assane Diao (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It's a throw-in for Betis.
2' The linesman raises his flag. Rodri (Betis) is adjudged offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Valencia will have the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will referee today's match.
